授業科目の概要.科目名称: 課題研究（人と社会領域）〔Law in Modern Society〕
授業科目の概要.対象学部等: 共創学部/School of Interdisciplinary Science and Innovation
授業科目の概要.曜日時限: 秋学期 月曜日 ２時限

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 本講義では、現代社会が直面する様々な課題や現象を概観し、法思想や社会学の知見を基に、考えられるアプローチや解決策について考察します。具体的な解決策そのものよりも、その根底にあるメカニズムの理解と問題解決ツールの発展に重点が置かれています。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: The course surveys different challenges and phenomena modern societies face and discusses possible approaches and solutions drawing on legal thought and sociology. The focus lies more towards the development of a deeper understanding of underlying mechanisms and problem-solving tools rather than of concrete solutions.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Legal thinking; law and modern society
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: There are no specific prerequisites. The course is designed with the understanding that undergraduate students are encountering various topics for the first time, so prior specialized knowledge is not assumed. Students who are eager to engage actively in the course and contribute to in-depth discussions are encouraged to join.

授業科目の実施方法について.備考: As a disclaimer, it is not necessary to read the entire books/works of the indicated authors. An introduction to the works will be given in the course; relevant passages will be made available through Moodle.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.定期試験: Final exam in form of essay question based on the contents discussed in class (approximately 30 per cent of the final grade).
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.発表: Every student is expected to participate in an in-class group presentation (group size depends on class size, each group ideally comprises of two to four students). The performance in the group presentation will constitute approximately 30 per cent of the final grade. Topics will be discussed in class.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.授業への貢献度: The class relies on class participation. Students are expected to attend classes prepared to be able to contribute knowledgeably to our discussions. Class participation constitutes approximately 40 per cent of the final grade.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.出席: Students are expected to attend all classes. In case of non-attendance, please be sure to give prior notice and provide a reason.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.備考: Consultation is possible before or after classes, or by e-mail. For longer consultations, you may also visit the office/lab after having scheduled an appointment.
